conditions.spawn_egg_recipe: Enabled for every reviewed eligible living creature with registered inputs; a reusable JEM SpawnEggItem is registered when the owning mod has no usable native egg

conditions.spawner_policy: YES allows normal reprogramming, NO rejects only spawn-egg reprogramming without affecting natural or existing spawners, SLOW_24000_TICKS allows at most one successful spawn per spawner per Minecraft day

change.summary: Add the verified Major Update 4 mod set, craftable native spawn eggs, shared spawner policy, Silk Touch spawner preservation, recruit equipment restrictions, Better Horses integration, and updated guide surfaces while retiring Horseman.

modifiers.before: No Major Update 4 generated recipe catalog
modifiers.after: 430 reviewed full-grid spawn egg recipes with unique ingredient multisets, including 15 Better Horses breeds and 25 JEM fallback eggs
Shared YES, NO, or one-success-per-24000-ticks policy loaded from the generated catalog
Silk Touch drops the spawner with its block-entity spawn data and cooldown state, without bonus eggs
Vanilla leather through diamond combat equipment is allowed, while netherite and all modded equipment are safely returned
All spawn eggs are permanently excluded from NPC buy and sell paths

modifiers.before: Horseman 1.3.17 and its JEM quest integration were active
modifiers.after: Horseman, its configuration, localization and quest integration are retired

cause.owner: JEMCompat, JEMAchievementGuide, JEMEconomy, JEMSettlements, MobHome and native third-party mods

rationale.purpose: Implement the complete supplied Major Update 4 specification on a development branch while preserving native mod ownership and server authority.
rationale.decision_source: The user supplied the specification and seven mod artifacts. Codex selected conservative registry verification, excluded unresolved class-review candidates, reused native interfaces, and kept authoritative validation on the server.

introduced.summary: Implement Major Update 4 from develop for test jem.

history.summary: Implement the registry-verified update, integrations and Horseman retirement.

notes: Generated recipes use fully filled shaped 3x3 patterns with unique ingredient multisets; missing native egg items are replaced by registered reusable JEM eggs for the same installed entity type.
Better Horses reuses native AbstractHorse support for recruits and adds exact MobHome companion classes.
Item Magnet affects world item entities only, so unclaimed JEM Rewards pending storage remains unchanged.
unresolved: No gameplay test or player acceptance was performed.
